finalText:
All 5 tests pass now.

The bug was in `computeTotal` in `src/services/pricing.js:9-23`: flat coupon amounts are stored in USD (per `coupon.js`), but the code was subtracting that raw USD amount from the already-currency-converted total — treating a USD amount as if it were in the target currency. Fixed by subtracting the flat coupon in USD *before* converting, so a $10 coupon on a $100 EUR order now correctly computes `(100 - 10) * 0.9 = 81` instead of `100 * 0.9 - 10 = 80`.
